tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// sgrol ma g.yul bzlog gi cho ga'i ngag 'don tshogs gsum dad pa'i rdza rnga zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo wā gin+d+ra nan+da ma ti ye/ gang la dad gsum gsol btab grur zhugs na// sdug bsngal kun 'byung nyal 'gro che las bsgral// ci 'dod dngos grub dbyig gi dpal ster ba// myur ma dpa' mos don mthun mchog la 'dud// 'phags mchog klu sgrub yab mes bka' yi phab// mar me mdzad dpal bha gī rā thā yis// bsil ldan sems can lha bu'i sgrib sbyong du// legs par drangs pa'i bka' srol mtho ris klung*// mkhas grub gong ma'i mkhyen rab nor 'dzin gzhir// yongs 'khyil lag len ma spros spros pa'i rlab// rnam par g.yo ba'i bka' srol 'khor lo'i lag /mthong don tshogs gsum mgrin pa'i rdza rnga brdung*// 'dir sgrol ma g.yul bzlog ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la/ snyigs dus kyi 'gro ba rnams la byad ka dang mthu bzlog pa dang*/ mna' zos pa dang*/ gza' skar ngan pa'i gnod pa dang*/ rdzas ngan dang*/ lha 'dre drag po dang 'gras pa'i gnod pa bzlog pa dang*/ rims nad dang*/ god ka gcod pa dang*/ mdor na nyes pa thams cad bzlog cing dge legs thams cad spel ba'i phyir/ mgon po klu sgrub nas brgyud pa'i sgrol mdos kyi cho ga bya ba la/ sngon rgya gar shar phyogs su rgyal po zhig gis mu stegs skad chen gyi bu bsad pas mu stegs des rgyal po 'khor bcas klu la gtad/ de'i sang nub rgyal po'i pho brang du sbrul chen po ha ha zer ba byung bas rgyal po 'khor bcas brgyal zhing 'chi bar thug pa'i tshe/ mchod gnas nang pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta zhig gis cho ga 'di byas pas/ sbrul des rgyal po'i ling ga chu mig nas bton/ mu stegs kyi spyi bo mchus gzhibs te shi/ yang za hor gyi yul du rgyal po bhi ga zhes pas sde brgyad drag shul can thams cad khyad du bsad/ mi dge'i spyod pa sna tshogs byas pas/

snang srid kyi lha 'dre thams cad khros te thabs gang gis kyang ma phan par gu ru mthar byed ces bya bas cho ga 'di byas pas mi nor rgyas shing phun sum tshogs par gyur pa byin rlabs che ba'i lo rgyus shin tu mang zhing*/ mkhas grub mang pos phyag len mdzad/ jo bo chen pos bsnams te ston pa rin po che la gnang nas rim par brgyud pa'o// de ji ltar bya ba la/ sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang por gnas khang byi dor byas shing yid du 'ong bar stegs mtho ba la dri bzang dang spang rgyan sngon pos byug pa byas te rdul tshon nam/ ras bris kyi pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa bkod pa'i steng mañdzi sogs kyi khar rje btsun ma'i sku rab gnas can bzhugs su gsol/ de nyid kyi dbu thog tu dar dkar po'i gur phub/ de'i mdun du bum pa/ mgur chings/ kha rgyan/ nang chu dang bum rdzas nyer lngas bkang ba'i khar gzungs rdor bzhag pa dang*/ mtha' nas chu gsum nyer spyod rnams tshang ba nyer bzhi nyung mtha' byas nas bskor/ pad 'dab btags pa'i zlum gtor bzhi so sor bshams/ de'i g.yas g.yon gang rigs su mdos gdan gyi steng du rin po che brdar ba bsres pa'i 'jim pa la/ spe'u spe zhol lcags ri dang bcas pa ji ltar 'tsham ba'i nang du zan las byas pa'i ngar mi mtho gang ba gser g.yu'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ rta la bskyon pa g.yas g.yon rgyab mdun rnams la nam mkha' dang*/ rgyang bu gsum gsum/ pho gdong mo gdong*/ mda' khra phang khra rnams kyang gsum gsum las mi nyung ba 'dzugs/ rin po che brdar ba bsres pa'i zan gyi ngar mi sum

rgyal ba lnga pas bcu gsum gsum gsungs/ cu/ mdzo rta gnag lug ri dwags sogs dang*/ sa la 'dzul dgu dang*/ gnam la 'phur dgu'i gzugs dang*/ 'bru sna/ zas sna/ sman sna/ rin po che/ ja gos dar/ mdor na 'dod dgu sna tshogs pas lcags ri'i nang 'gengs/ la dgu lung dgu'i sa sna chu sna yang tshogs par bya/ de'i mdun du chu gnyis nyer spyod rnams tshang pa tshar gsum bshams pa'i mthar/ pad 'dab btags pa'i zlum gtor gnyis kyi bar du/ gzhi bdag dkar gtor/ pad 'dab med pa'i zlum gtor gsum la zan ril mang tsam gyis bskor ba/ ngar mi'i steng du dar dkar gyi gur phub/ spe'u steng du mda' dar ram nam mkha' sgrol ma'i sku'i tsa ka li'i brgyan pa 'dzugs so// bka' gdams pa dang ba ri'i lugs sogs byed na de yan gyi thus/ gal te gu ru drag po yi dam byed na de ga'i gong du maṇ+ḍal la nas kyi tshom bu bkod pa'i mdun du gtor ma stod zur can dmar po rgyan ldan dang*/ sman rag nyer spyod tshang bar rnams dang*/ yi dam dang gur zhal sogs kyi gtor bsngo tsam mam bskang gso byed na de dag gi mchod gtor rnams kyang bsham mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ spyir bshad pa dang*/ sgos don bye brag tu bshad pa'o// dang po la/ bka' gdams pa ltar na jo bo'i lugs kyi sgrol ma'i bdag bskyed dang*/ mdun bskyed mdos chog sogs yig rnying gi dngos bstan tsam mdzad nas gnod pa'i phyogs su mdos bskyal ba tsam las zor sogs gzhan gyi rgyas 'gebs rnams gtan nas bzhag mi dgos la/ yang jo lugs 'di sa lugs kyi phyag len ltar na/ bca' bsham phal cher gong gi yig rnying ltar bya/ sngon 'gro gtor ma bran la/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ 'bru gsum lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥzhes pas 'jig rten skyong ba'i 'byung po rnams bkug

sngags de la a kā ro btags pa lan gsum mam lngas bsngos la/ 'jig rten pa yi 'byung po sogs nas/ byang chub thob pa'i grogs kyang mdzod// zhes dang*/ lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha/ zhes pas gtor ma phyi rol du dor la gshegs su gsol/ de nas mchod pa byin rlabs dang*/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ye shes tshogs bsags bcas sngon tu btang nas/ sgrol ma yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed de/ bzlas pa 'dod gsol gdan bsdu ba'i bar sgrub thabs ba ri'i lugs kyi brgya rtsa'am/ gnyan sgrol yan lag drug pa'i bsgom bzlas gang rung ltar nyams su blangs nas/ mchod pa rnams rang rang gi gzhung ltar byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ mdun bskyed a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las/ gnas de nyid 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i 'od zer du 'khrugs pa zhes sogs nas/ mi tshe dge zhing dngos grub ma lus stsol// zhes pa'i bar 'og nas 'byung ba ltar nyams su blangs/ lan kha yar btang ba'i tshe mchod gtor dang yas rnams gsos la byin rlabs byas la/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi mchod pa nas bzung 'dis bar shar mar btang ngo*// de ltar byed tshe sman rag gtor gsum dang tshogs 'khor med/ sgrol ma'i gtor 'bul yan la dril gsil gdangs dang mchod rol sogs skabs su gang bab tsam las rnga rol dbyangs sogs spros pa med do// de tsam nas mdos gong bzhin skyel ba las zor gyi spros pa yang med/ 'on kyang zor rgyas pa la dga' na khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba sogs kyis mdzad pa'i gdugs dkar mdos chen gyi zor de 'dir sbyar bas sa lugs dang bu lugs kyi phyag len dri med du 'gro'o// deng sang sa lugs la sgrol ma g.yul bzlog gi phyag len dar srol che ba ni kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa chen po kun dga' rnam rgyal gyi ring lugs 'dzin pa rnams dang*/ rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i mdos chog mthong ba don grub las/

sman rag gtor gsum gyi mchod pa dang tshogs 'khor zor 'phen sogs spros pa che tsam mdzad pa'i rjes 'brang phyag len mdzad pa ding sang mang zhing*/ khyad par khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa nas/ lnga pa chen po'i gsung rab gzhir bzhag la yi dam chos skyong rnams kyi gtor bsngo bskang gso bcas sbyar nas/ thams cad la dbyangs gdangs rnga brdung rol mo sogs rgyas par stsal ltar/ 'dir yang yon mchod spros pa la thugs dgyes pa rnams kyi ngo bor sa lugs kyi gu ru drag dmar me phreng can gyi gzhung dregs pa'i zil gnon dang sbags te/ sgrol ma g.yul bzlog gi lag len klags chog tu bkod pa la drug ste/ bdag lhas rnal 'byor/ mdun bskyed bsgrub pa/ mchod bstod bya ba/ gtor ma btang ba/ glud rdzas bsngo ba/ zor lam bstan pa ste/ dang po la'ang sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang por/ gu ru drag po phrin las kyi gzhung nas 'byung ba ltar sngon 'gro gtor ma 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ sarba bigh+nān ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥzhes pas bgegs rigs bkug la/ sngags de nyid la na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo sogs btags pa lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ hūm̐ bka' gsang rmad byung sogs kyis bgegs gtor btang ba dang mtshams bcad pa sngon du btang nas/ bdag lhas rnal 'byor las sngon 'gro ni/ bla ma bde gshegs sogs kyi skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yan lag bdun pa byin 'bebs yo byad byin gyis brlabs nas/ gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi bdag mdun tha mi dad par lha bskyed pa nas/ bzlas pa'i rjes su 'dod don zhu ba'i bar gzhung ltar nyams su blang ba ni 'dir bla med kyi las byang sngon du btang ba yin no// gnyis pa mdun bskyed la bgegs gtor mtshams bcad rnams sngon du song zin pas 'dir mi dgos la/

rang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas bye ba'i gu ru drag po'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ mdun gyi mchod rdzas la bsang chu gtor zhing byin gyis brlab pa ni/ swa bh+wa was snod bcud thams cad stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa dang bh+rum̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod gtor rnams ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i ro mchog brgya dang ldan pa/ gzugs mdzes/ sgra snyan/ dri zhim/ ro bda'/ reg bya 'jam pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ zhal bsil/ zhabs bsil/ yon chab la sogs pa mchod pa'i bye brag dpag tu med pas nam mkha' dang sa gzhi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad mchod pa'i bye brag dang 'dod yon bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang bar gyur/ sman rag gtor gsum sogs phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas rnams rang rang gi byed las khyad par can/ dpal kun du bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra añtsa ma naṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shra mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ uṅga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga gan khaṃ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha/ zhes pas sman dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta ba la ba te gu h+ya sid+dhi sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭha/ zhes gtor ma dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭha zhes rak+ta dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta/ tsit+ta/ go ro tsa na/ kiṃ ni ri ti/ ma hā pū dza hoḥ zhes nang gi mchod pa dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bo dhi tsit+ta ga na gu h+ya ma hā pū dza hoḥ zhes gsang ba'i mchod pa rnams ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlab/ gnyis pa sgos don bye brag pa la rten gyi lha bskyed pa dang*/

mchod bstod bya ba'o// dang po ni/ swa bh+wa was stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las gnas de nyid 'ja' tshon lnga'i 'od dang zer du 'khrugs pa/ khyad par in+d+ra nī la'i mdog steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun tu'ang ljang gur gsal ba dag par gyur pa'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma sngon po 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i gdan dang rgyab yol gyi dbus su tām̐ yig ljang gu 'od zer lnga ru 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad mchod/ sems can gyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ don gnyis byas tshur 'dus tāṃ la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma sku mdog ljang gu/ phyag g.yas pa mchog sbyin/ g.yon pa ut+pa la'i yu ba mtheb srin gyis bzung nas snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum/ zhal 'dzum 'od zer dang ldan zhing dbu gtsug na snang ba mtha' yas kyis brgyan pa/ gzhon nu lang tsho rgyas pa bcu drug lon pa'i nu ma 'bur ba/ sku ldem la 'gying bag dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan thams cad rdzogs pa/ dbu rgyan snyan rgyan phyag gdub zhabs gdub do shal dpung rgyan la sogs rgyan du mas spras pa/ dbu skra gnag cing li ba spyi bor bcings pa/ zar bu 'phyang ba dar sna lnga'i stod g.yogs dang*/ dar dmar po'i sham thabs can nam mkha'i 'ja' 'am chu nang gi zla ba ltar snang la gdos bcas su ma grub pa 'od zer dang ldan pa'i skur gyur/ de'i mtha' skor du'ang phrin las lha mo sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ mthing ga dang tām̐ yig ljang gu/ lte bar hrīḥser po/ thugs ka'i yig 'bru gnyis las 'od 'phros/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi lho nub/ nub phyogs o rgyan yul gyi shar ri bo po ta la byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs kyi gnas dang*/

lho phyogs seng ldeng gi nags tshal rnams nas rje btsun ma sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes dang*/ hūm̐ chos sku skye med ngang nyid las// thugs rje'i smon lam las 'khrungs pa// longs spyod rdzogs sku mtshan dpes spras// bcom ldan thugs rje'i ngang can ma// tshur gshegs rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum// 'phags ma sgrol ma gshegs su gsol// po ta la yi gnas mchog nas// thugs rje'i spyan dang tāṃ yig las// 'gro ba skyob par sku sprul ma// yid bzhin dngos grub kun gyi gter// 'gro ba mgon med rnams la ni// brtse ba chen pos gshegs su gsol// 'jigs brgyad zhi dang tshe dbang rgyas// khams gsum dbang sdud drag po yis// mi mthun phyogs rnams bzlog pa dang*// bdag la mchog dang thun mong sogs// re ba'i 'dod don ma lus pa// thams cad stsol phyir gshegs su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā rā sa pa ri wā ra sa mā ya dzaḥ zhes rje btsun ma'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig la byon nas mdun gyi nam mkhar khra phung bzhugs pa la rang thal mo sbyar la/ ji snyed su dag gam/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs yan lag bdun pa gang yang rung ba cig 'bul lo// hūm̐ bsod nams dang ni ye shes kyi// tshogs gnyis rnam dag las grub pa'i// pho brang gzhal yas 'od du 'bar// pad+ma ge sar zla ba'i steng*// bcom ldan 'phags ma'i tshogs rnams kun// dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā rā sa pa ri wā ra sa mā ya tiṣ+ṭhan+tu/ zhes pas nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pas nam mkha'i ye shes pa rnams dam tshig pa bskyed pa la chu dang chu 'dres pa ltar dbyer med du bzhugs par bsam/ slar yang thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad rigs lnga'i rnam par gong ltar spyan drangs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'di rnams la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab pas de rnams kyis oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa mā ya shrī ye hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso mo la 'od dpag med dang*/ gzhan rnams la yang rang rang gi rigs bdag gis dbur brgyan par bsam/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ e ma ho/ dus gsum sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yum// 'gro drug bu bzhin skyong ba'i ma// rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro drug sdug bsngal gzir ba la// byams pa'i thugs rjes skyob mdzad ma// sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// las kyi me chen 'bar ba la// thugs rje'i chu yis bsil mdzad ma// 'phags ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// snyigs ma'i 'gro ba nyon mongs la// 'phags ma khyed ni lhag par brtse// thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi zag med blo yis ni// mos pas skad cig dran pas kyang*// sdug bsngal sgrol la phyag 'tshal lo// lha mo thugs rje'i ngang can ma// brtse dang mkhyen dang nus par ldan// yid bzhin ma la phyag 'tshal lo// dus min 'chi ba la sogs pa// mi mthun phyogs rnams kun skyob ma// skyabs chen ma la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā rā sa pa ri wā ra a ti pu ho/ pra ti dza hoḥzhes phyag bya'o// gnyis pa mchod bstod bya ba la gnyis te/ thun mong dang bye brag gi'o// dang po la bzhi ste/ mchod bstod/ bshags pa/ smre sngags/ dbang blang ba'o// thog mar sku khrus gsol ba ni/ hūm̐ sngon gyi rgyal ba 'jig rten mgon// lum+bi'i tshal du bltams pa na// tshangs dang brgya byin lha rnams kyis// ji ltar dag pa'i khrus gsol ltar// dri ldan chab ni dge ba'i chus// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// ye shes mchog gi 'phags ma ni// gtso 'khor lha yi tshogs rnams la// sku la sgrib g.yogs mi mnga' yang*// bdag cag sgrib pa sbyang ba dang*// 'gro rnams bsod nams bsag pa'i phyir// dag byed chu yis sku khrus gsol// bdag sogs nyon mongs sgrib dag nas// dri ma med pa'i sku thob shog

/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes bum chu yod tshe me long ngos la sku khrus gsol// med na mos pa tsam bya/ de nas dar ram ras dri ma med pa thogs te/ hūm̐ dri bral yang dag mchog gi sku mnga' ba// sred dang chags sogs dri ma mi mnga' yang*// gtsang dang dri zhim ldan pa'i gos dag gis// 'phags ma'i tshogs rnams dga' bas sku phyi'o// oṃ hūm̐ traṃ hrīḥ.āḥ kā ya bi sho dha ni swā hā// zhes pas sku phyi/ lha yi na bza' pañtsa li ka dang*// dri med dag pa kā shi ka yi ras// rje btsun 'phags ma 'khor dang bcas pa dang*// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun la dbul bar bgyi'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā rā sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra was+t+ra ya āḥhūm̐/ zhes na bza' 'bul lo// mchod pa'i bye brag rnams 'bul ba ni/ dang po phyi mchod rnams las chu gsum 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐ dri med gtsang zhing dag pa bdud rtsi'i chu// yan lag brgyad ldan bkra shis dge ba'i rdzas// spos dang ga pur tsan+dan la sogs pa// bsil dang ngad ldang bde ba skyed byed pa// zhal bsil zhabs bsil yon chab la sogs pa// rje btsun 'phags ma'i tshogs la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā rā sa pa ri wā ra a tsa ma na pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ de nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni/ spyi dang mthun pa rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba lan gsum dbul lo// hūm̐ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor spyan la mchod 'bul ma// lha mo dkar mo rab mdzes ngang tshul can// dkar ser dmar ljang mthing ga'i mdangs ldan pa'i// sgeg ma'i phyag na me tog sna tshogs thogs// rje btsun 'phags ma'i tshogs la dbul bar bgyi'o// sngags kyi mthar badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor shangs la mchod 'bul ma// lha mo ser mo rab mdzes ngang tshul can// ga pur tsan+dan rgya shug la sogs pa'i// sgeg ma'i phyag na bdug spos sna tshogs bsnams// rje btsun 'phags ma'i tshogs la dbul bar bgyi'o// badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/

rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor thugs la mchod 'bul ma// lha mo dmar mo rab mdzes ngang tshul can// 'bru mar rtsi mar snang gsal 'od kyi tshogs// sgeg ma'i phyag na snang gsal dpag med bsnams// rje btsun 'phags ma'i tshogs la dbul bar bgyi'o// badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor sku la mchod 'bul ma// lha mo ljang gu rab mdzes ngang tshul can// tsan+dan gur gum ga pur sih+la sogs// sgeg ma'i phyag na dri chab dpag med bsnams// rje btsun 'phags ma'i tshogs la dbul bar bgyi'o// badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ljags la mchod 'bul ma// lha mo dkar mo rab mdzes ngang tshul can// rang byung lhan skyes sbyar ba'i zhal zas sogs// sgeg ma'i phyag na zhal zas dpag med bsnams// rje btsun 'phags ma'i tshogs la dbul bar bgyi'o// badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor snyan la mchod 'bul ma// lha mo sngon mo rab mdzes ngang tshul can// rnga dung dril bu pi waṃ gling bu'i sgra// sgeg ma'i phyag na sil snyan dpag med bsnams// rje btsun 'phags ma'i tshogs la dbul bar bgyi'o// badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes rol mo bcas bya'o// yid byung mchod pa ni/ dpral bar nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ sarba bit+pū ra pū ra su ra su ra a brta ya a brta ya ho zhes pas spel la/ hūm̐ srid par gtogs pa'i 'jig rten rab 'byams na// gzugs mchog rab mdzes ji snyed yod pa kun// rdo rje gzugs ma'i tshogs su kun sprul nas// rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum la dbul bar bgyi'o// badz+ra rū pa āḥhūm̐/ srid par gtogs pa'i྾ /smra mchog skad snyan྾ /rdo rje sgra ma'i tshogs su྾ /rgyal ba bskyed pa'i྾ /badz+ra shap+da āḥhūm̐/ srid par gtogs pa'i྾ /dri mchog bzang po྾ /rdo rje dri ma'i tshogs su྾ /rgyal ba bskyed pa'i྾ /badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ srid par gtogs pa'i྾

/longs spyod ro mchog྾ /rdo rje ro ma'i tshogs su྾ /rgyal ba bskyed pa'i྾ /badz+ra ra sa āḥhūm̐/ srid par gtogs pa'i྾ /rab mdzes na bza'྾ /rdo rje reg ma'i tshogs su྾ /rgyal ba bskyed pa'i྾ /badz+ra spar+ṣe āḥhūm̐/ srid par gtogs pa'i྾ /snang srid chos mchog྾ /rdo rje chos ma'i tshogs su྾ /rgyal ba bskyed pa'i྾ /badz+ra dharma dhā tu āḥhūm̐/ ye shes bde ba'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ rdo rje rigs kyi rje btsun 'phags ma la// zhe sdang ngo bo rnam par dag pa yi// me long ye shes bde ba'i mchod pa 'bul// kun du bde ba'i mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /rin chen rigs kyi rje btsun྾ /nga rgyal ngo bo rnam par྾ /mnyam nyid ye shes bde ba'i྾ /kun du bde ba'i mchod pas྾ /pad+ma rigs kyi rje btsun྾ /'dod chags ngo bo rnam par྾ /sor rtog ye shes bde ba'i྾ /kun du bde ba'i mchod pas྾ /las kyi rigs kyi rje btsun྾ /phrag dog ngo bo rnam par྾ /bya grub ye shes bde ba'i྾ /kun du bde ba'i mchod pas྾ /de bzhin rigs kyi rje btsun྾ /gti mug ngo bo rnam par྾ /chos dbyings ye shes྾ /kun du bde ba'i mchod pas྾ /dzñā na su kha pū dza sa ma ye hūm̐/ gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ ba ri lugs sogs byed na sman dang rak+ta'i mchod pa dor la/ gtor ma byin rlabs rang rang gi dkyus nas 'byung ba ltar dang*/ mtshan sngags sngar bzhin gyi mthar/ a kā ro btags pa'i lan gsum mam bdun gyis phul bas thus/ 'dir ni byin rlabs gong du song bas mi dgos la/ 'bul ba'i tshul ni/ hūm̐ ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma ni// rang byung rnam dag bdud rtsi'i ngo bo nyid// ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yi phung por gsal// mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pas gang*// sha lnga bdud rtsi sman gtor rak+ta'i tshogs// dpag tu med pa'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'dis// rje btsun 'phags ma'i lha tshogs mnyes gyur cig

/mtshan sngags gong gi mthar/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta pi wa tha/ ma hā ba lin+ta bhu dze kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis sman raka gtor ma bcas dbul/ bstod pa bya ba ni/ sgrol bstod phan yon skabs las/ gnyis gsum bdun du mngon par brjod na// zhes 'byung ba ltar te/ hūm̐ spyan ras gzigs dbang brtse ba'i thugs rje can// 'gro ba kun gzigs dag pa'i spyan nyid las// 'gro ba'i don du sprul pa'i bcom ldan ma// brtse ba'i thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal bstod// zhal gcig phyag gnyis in+d+ra nī la'i mdog /gzhon nu lang tsho bcu drug lon pa'i tshul// g.yas pa mchog sbyin g.yon pa ut+pa la// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal bstod// rin chen rgyan spras 'dzum pa'i 'od zer can// longs spyod rab rdzogs rgyan rnams ma lus rdzogs// phrin las rnam bzhi dngos grub kun gyi gter// dgos 'dod re skong ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces dang*/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig bstod pa tshar gnyis bton rjes su/ bum pa la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu dpag tu med pa 'phros te/ 'khor 'das snod bcud thams cad kyi mthu stobs nus pa dang*/ mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi byin rlabs thams cad bsdus nas bum pa'i nang du thim par gyur par dmigs la/ slob dpon gyi gzungs thag nas bzung la/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa 'ur 'don bzla/ ār+ya tā re/ zhes pa'ang brgya tshar gyi rjes su yang sgrol bstod tshar gsum 'don/ yang sngags de nyid 'ur 'don brgya rtsa re bya/ slar yang sgrol bstod phyag 'tshal nyer gcig tshar bdun dang*/ yang bsnyen pa gnyis brgya rtsa re bzlas mthar gzungs thag bsdus la/ bshags pa bya ba ni/ mos gus tshad med pas yid kyis 'gyod pa skyes te thal mo snying gar sbyar la/

rje btsun 'phags ma'i lha tshogs thams cad dgongs// bdag cag ma rig rmongs shing las ngan pas// mi dge las kyi sgrib tshogs ci bgyis pa// gnongs shing 'gyod sems drag pos mthol shing bshags// ma ltar byams pa'i thugs rjes dgongs nas kyang*// nyes byas sgrib pa'i tshogs rnams byang bar shog /badz+ra sa ma ya shud+dhe a/ zhes yig brgya nyer gcig 'ur 'don bya/ thugs dam gnad nas bskul zhing smre sngags kyis gsol ba btab pa ni/ rje btsun ma'i rten gyi drung du thal sbyar pus btsugs lus ba spu g.yo bas/ gdong mchi ma 'byin cing bu ma la dungs nas ngu ba'i tshul du bya zhing*/ kyi hud 'phags ma byams ldan thugs rje can// rgyal ba'i yum khyod gnas mchog gang na bzhugs// skyabs med bdag la dgos pa'i dus byung ngo*// thog med dus nas da lta thug gi bar// rigs drug 'khor ba'i g.yang sa dong ring 'dir// skye ba grangs med sha khrag lus blangs kyang*// byas pa'i las la don med chud re zos// skye ba lan cig tsam zhig thar pa'i lam// bsgrubs pa'i 'brel yang bdag gis ma zhogs sam// 'phags ma'i thugs rjes bdag nyid btang srid dam// thugs rjes gzung dang 'phags ma rgyal ba'i yum// bdag ni ma rig las ngan sdig sgrib can// mgon med bdag ni ma yis ma gzigs sam// gdungs pa'i nga ros 'o dod bos lags na// ma khyod brtse ba'i thugs rjes mi 'dzin nam// rigs drug 'khor ba'i dong du lhung lags na// 'phags ma thugs rje'i zhags pas mi 'dren nam// ma rig mun pa'i yul du gtan 'khyams na// 'phags ma thugs rje'i sgron me mi spor ram// las kyi yul du dbang med 'khyams lags na// ma gcig thugs rje'i lcags kyus mi 'dzin nam// dge ba'i myu gu lo tog skams lags na// 'phags ma thugs rje'i char rgyun mi 'bebs sam// zhe sdang dug lnga'i me chen 'bar lags na// ma khyod thugs rje'i chu yis mi brlan nam// dug gsum 'khrul pa'i nad kyis gdungs lags na// ma khyod thugs rje'i sman gyis mi gso 'am// dus 'dir ma khyod thugs rjes ma bzung na// deng nas phyin chad nges pa'i gnas med do// kye ma kyi hud 'phags ma thugs rje can// bdag la re ltos skyabs gnas gzhan na med// skyid sdug re ltos ci shes khyod shes na// thugs rje'i dpa' mtshon skyed cig rje btsun ma// 'khor ba'i gnas su yun ring gtan 'khyams na// nam zhig las zad 'bras bu thob pa'i tshe// 'phags ma'i thugs rjes ci 'tshal don ma mchis// las dbang btsan zhes bdag nyid bor gyur na// thugs rje che zhes skyabs gnas su la byed// 'phags ma khyod la thugs rje'i stobs mnga' zhing*// sngon 'brel gsol btab bden pa ma bsrungs na// thugs la le lo btang snyoms mi mdzad par// skad cig nyid la thar par 'dren du gsol// tshe 'dir mi mthun rkyen ngan bar gcod dang*// rgyal po me chu lcags sgrog dug dang mtshon// rims nad sna tshogs chom rkun dus min 'chi// dgra dang bgegs dang rmi lam mtshan ltas ngan// chag che nyam nga 'jigs pa brgyad la sogs// ma lus zhi zhing bzlog par mdzad du gsol// tshe dbang longs spyod dpal 'byor phrin las rnams// gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod// khams gsum srid gsum snang srid thams cad kyi// snang ba dbang du 'du bar mdzad du gsol// bdud dang dgra bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs rnams kun// tshar gcod drag po'i phrin las mdzad du gsol// bdag ni rtse gcig zol zog med pa yis// kha tsam ma yin snying nas gsol btab pas// 'gro 'dug las byed gang gi phyogs dag tu'ang*// bu gcig ma bzhin brtse bas bskyang du gsol// 'di dang phyi ma bar do'i gnas skabs su// 'bral med rtag tu thugs rjes bzung du gsol// bdag gi rgyud la mi rtag byams snying rje// dad dang brtson 'grus nges 'byung skyo shas dang*// zab mo'i don dang stong nyid lta ba'i mchog

/rtag tu nyams len skyo ngal med pa dang*// tshe dang sgrub pa mtha' ru phyin par shog /ces skad cig ma yengs par sems dung dung bas gsol ba gdab bo// dbang bskur ba ni/ bum pa rje btsun ma rten dang bcas pa skad cig gis gsal ba de/ tshogs pa mang po dang yon bdag bcas yod tshe mchod g.yog pas gral gsham nas langs te/ bum pa thogs la/ rje btsun ma dngos su gsal ba'i gnas bzhi nas bskyed rim gyi skabs ltar gnas bzhi nas yig 'bru bzhi las 'od zer bar ma chad par rang rang gi gnas bzhir 'phros shing thim par bsgom zhing*/ thams cad kyi ngag tu/ hūm̐ rje btsun 'phags ma thugs rje can// rnam dag sku yi sgo phyes la// mi 'gyur rdo rje tshe yi dbang*// skal ldan lus la bskur du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā rā sa pa ri wā ra kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ rje btsun 'phags ma thugs rje can// 'gag med gsung gi sgo phyes la// 'gag med rnam grol gsung gi dbang*// skal ldan ngag la bskur du gsol// sngags gong bzhin gyi mthar/ wāka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ rje btsun 'phags ma thugs rje can// spros bral thugs kyi sgo phyes la// spros med rdo rje thugs kyi dbang*// skal ldan yid la bskur du gsol// tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ rje btsun 'phags ma thugs rje can// sku gsung yongs rdzogs sgo phyes la// phrin las rnam bzhi 'gro don dbang*// skal ldan lus ngag yid la bskur// sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ bum pa rang gzhan gyi gnas bzhir gtugs shing bum chu btung zhing dbang blang*/ rang gcig pu las med na bum pa rang gis thogs la gnas bzhir gtugs shing dbang blang ngo*// mchod gtor yas byin rlabs ni/ gnyis pa bye brag gi mchod bstod bya ba la/ yo byad byin gyis brlab pa/ mdun bskyed gsal btab pa/ bye brag gi mchod bstod bya ba'o// mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa dang mdos yas rnams la dmigs te/

bdag bskyed gang yin skabs kyi mchod gtor byin rlabs rnams byas rjes/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ mdun du rin po che las grub pa'i khang bzang lcags ris bskor ba rtse zhol du yon bdag rnams kyi glud/ phung khams skye mched rnams yongs su rdzogs pa mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba/ nam mkha' rgyang bu/ mda' khra/ phang khra/ pho gdong*/ mo gdong*/ gtor ma/ rin po che/ 'bru/ sman sogs mthun pa'i rdzas thams cad bzang zhing gya nom pa/ sa dang bar snang nam mkha'i khyon thams cad yongs su gang ba/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur/ ces dang*/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar te/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ skyon sbyangs/ lag pa gnyis mnyam pa'i thal mo las sor mo la sor mo dbus ma gsum gyi tshigs pa bar ma gsum bcag pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya smin mtshams su bcas la/ oṃ na mas+sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu kha bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hās rgyas par spel/ lag pa gnyis thal mo sbyar ba mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i rgyab tu kha dbye la sbyar/ mthe bong gnyis bsnol ba bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bdud rtsir sbyor/ g.yas khu tshur bcangs pa'i mdzub mo bsgreng g.yon khu tshur snying gar bzhag pa dang*/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐ gis rang rang 'dod pa thob par byas/ lag pa g.yon khu tshur bcangs pa pang bzhag g.yas khu tshur gyi mdzub mo bsgreng ba'i ye shes skar mda'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ dzñā na a wa lo ki te na mas+sa man+ta s+pha ra ṇa rasmi sam+bha wa sa ma ya ma hā ma ni du ru du ru hṛ da ya dz+wa la ni hūm̐/ rang dbang thob par byas/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje'i nang bsdams mthe bong gshibs pa spyi bo thad kar dbang bsgyur 'khor lo'i phyag rgya dang*/

na mas+sa man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ gra he shwa ri pra bhañdza ri ma hā sa ma ya swā hā/ mgron rnams so sor mnyes par bsam/ phyag rgya rnams phyogs bcur bstan zhing sngags rnams lan gsum gsum brjod/ mdun bskyed ni rje btsun ma'i sku gzugs la dmigs nas/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ sgo bzhi/ rgyan rta babs mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad kyi lte bar/ paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ tāṃ las ut+pa la tāṃ ljang gus mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das rje btsun sgrol ma sku mdog rin po che margad ltar ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhabs phyed skyil du bzhugs pa phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon me tog ut+pa la sngon po'i yu ba mtheb srin gyi bar du 'dzin pas 'dab ma snyan gyi thad du kha bye ba/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ sor gdub la sogs pa rgyan dpag tu med pas spras pa/ dar dkar po'i stod g.yogs dang*/ dar dmar po'i sham thabs can/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan pa ye shes 'od lnga 'khrigs pa'i dbus su bzhugs pa/ de'i mtha' skor du phrin las lha mo sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs sprin gyi phung po lta bus bskor ba'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ de las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas dang*/ g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing nas/ rje btsun sgrol ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun gyi sogs nas// yang dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol// po tā la yi gnas mchog nas// tāṃ yig ljang gu las byung ba'i// 'od dpag med pas dbu la brgyan// dus gsum sangs rgyas phrin las ma// 'gro ba'i don du gshegs su gsol// bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod// bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse/

nas// de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol// ji ltar bltams/ nas/ sku khrus gsol/ sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing*/ nas/ spyod par shog rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang*// bdag gi gus pas bshams pa 'di// rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā rā sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// zhabs bsil ji snyed nas bzung ste/ rol mo'i bar tshigs bcad sngags 'don pa bsgyur/ lha dang lha min cod paṇa gyi nas/ sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag 'tshal sgrol ma myur ma dpa' mo// spyan ni skad cig glog dang 'dra ma// 'jig rten gsum mgon chu skyes zhal gyi// ge sar bye ba las ni byung ma// zhes phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi dang po song rjes/ gong ltar chu gnyis nyer spyod kyi mchod pa 'bul/ de bzhin du/ phyag 'tshal ston ka'i zla ba kun tu// zhes pa nas bzung ste/ phyag 'tshal ba ni nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar sh+lau ka re dang*/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho ma tshar re spel/ bzhi pa gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ gtor ma cha bzhi'i dang po la dmigs nas/ oṃ mu la mā la shrī maṅgu ru/ a kā ro btags te lan gsum mam bdun gyis bla ma la/ oṃ tṛ rat+na la gtor sngags btags nas gtor ma gnyis pa dkon mchog spyi la/ yi ge bcu pa la gtor sngags btags nas gsum pa sgrol ma la/ gtor ma bzhi dmag zor gur zhal sogs gang mos la 'bul gsung kyang*/ yi dam chos skyong gur zhal nas mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi bar gtor chog ltar gtor ma rgyas pa phul/ de dag gi skabs su gtor chog gi gtor ma zur pa yod na de dang chabs cig tu sgrol mdos kyi gras la bshams pa'i srung ma'i gtor ma'ang 'bul ba'i dmigs pa bya/ de nas bstod thung res bstod/ bstan srung rnams kyi bskang gso byed na'ang skabs 'dir bya zhes sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros pas gsungs so// de nas mdos kyi mdun du 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma cha drug re byas te/

dang po phyogs skyong la cha gsum ltar/ gnyis pa gzhi bdag la/ gsum pa sde brgyad cha gsum ltar gtor ma bsngos rjes/ na mo dkon mchog gsum gyi mthu dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ rig sngags dang*/ gzungs sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi mthu dang*/ bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i mthus/ lha dang*/ klu dang*/ dri za dang*/ grul bum dang*/ sha za dang*/ srul po dang*/ brjed byed dang*/ smyo byed dang*/ dge rgad po dang*/ rgad mo dang*/ bu pho dang*/ bu mo dang*/ 'khor g.yog dang*/ ma mo mkha' 'gro dang*/ log 'dren dang*/ gshin rje dang*/ rgyal po dang*/ 'gong po dang*/ nam mkha' lding dang*/ gnyan dang*/ sa bdag dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ btsan dang*/ bdud dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ sha za dang*/ gza' dang*/ rgyu skar dang*/ lo dang*/ zla ba dang*/ zhag dang*/ za ma la sogs pa la gnod pa'i sbyor ba byed pa rnams zhi bar gyur cig ces brjod/ bzhi pa bgegs la cha gsum ltar bsngos rjes/ na mo dkon mchog gsum nas/ byin rlabs kyi bar gong ltar la/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu'i gnod sems dang gdug rtsub zhi bar gyur cig lnga pa rigs drug la/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po dang ldan par gyur cig oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ lan gsum mam bdun gang rung*/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs pa'i 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad la sbyin no// rigs drug so so'i lan chags bu lon byang zhing*/ sdug bsngal mtha' dag dang bral nas pha rol tu phyin pa drug rdzogs nas bla na med pa'i byang chub rin po che myur du thob par gyur cig

drug pa lan chags la bsang sbyangs byin rlabs nas/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di ni bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rgyu sbyor ba 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas lan chags kyi mgron bu lon ma 'khor ba dang*/ tshe 'di yang thugs zur dang*/ spyan zur la phog pa rnams dang gnod byed kyi tshogs ngos ma zin pa rnams la sbyin no// lan chags thams cad byang*/ bu lon thams cad khyer ba dang*/ sha 'khon du gyur pa dang*/ gnod byed tshogs rnams gtor ma 'dis mnyes shing re ba thams cad skong bar gyur cig ces brjod pa ni gtor ma'i rim pa'o// de nas ba ri lugs sogs byed na tshogs mchod mi dgos kyang*/ 'dir tshogs kyi yo byad rnams 'dus byas la/ oṃ sarba ḍa bya bi sho dha ni hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang gtor bya/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ zhes brjod pas yo byad kyi ma dag pa rnams bsreg gtor bkru ba lan gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥlan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐ pad+ma 'od kyis gzhal yas sogs/ phyogs bcu gar bzhugs gnas rnams nas// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams// tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// oṃ gu ru de wa ār+ya tā rā ḍa ka sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya hūm̐ dza dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs la/ tshogs mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐ bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das// sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid che// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// zhas zas tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// oṃ gu ru de wa ār+ya tā rā ḍa ka sa pa ri wā ra ga na tsakra pū dza khā hi/ hūm̐ hrīḥbaskang ngo gsol lo mchod do thugs dam bskang*// 'dod yon longs spyod rdzas kyi thugs dam bskang*// bskang ba med de khams gsum yongs kyi bskang*// sgrol ba med de khams gsum yongs kyi sgrol// sbyor ba med de khams gsum yongs kyi sbyor// ye grol ye sbyor chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// lta ba klong du gyur pas thugs dam bskang*// sgom pa yang sprul rkyen dang bral bas bskang*// spyod pa yang sprul tshul 'chos bral bas bskang*// 'bras bu lhun grub phyogs lhung bral bas bskang*// bka' rgyud bla ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// dam can rgya mtsho rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// rdo rje slob dpon gnyer gyi thugs dam bskang*// 'dus pa'i mched lcam rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// rigs drug pha ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// thugs dam bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol// zhes thugs dam bskangs nas/

bshags pa bya ba ni sngon byung dus nas da lta'i bar// ma rig dbang gi lus ngag sems// bag med dam las 'gal ba rnams// 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pas bshags// badz+ra sa ma ya ho zhes brjod/ de nas tshogs tha ma dgra bgegs bsgral ba ni/ dgra bgegs kyi liṅga mdun du bzhag la/ bden stobs brjod pas dgug gzhug bcings dang dbang du bya ba dang*/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba dang*/ sha khrag bstab pa rnams ni phrin las kyi gzhung dang*/ sngags 'chang chen po'i yig cha logs su gsal ba ltar bya'o// de nas sngags 'chang tshogs la rol pa ni/ tshogs phud rim pa rnams phul nas/ der slob dpon sogs tshogs pa du yod la 'gyed pa'i thog mar/ las kyi rdo rjes thogs te slob dpon la 'bul ba'i tshul bya ba dang*/ ho zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa sogs nas/ rgyan du rol/ a la la ho zhes dpon slob lhan cig pas brjod cing tshogs la rol rjes lhag ma rnams bsdus la/ slob dpon gyis pheṃ zhes 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas te chang gi kha phru btab la/ hūm̐ las kyi rdo rje phyed pas sogs nas/ grub par mdzod/ oṃ u ts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi zhes pas lhag gtor phyi rol du dor/ lnga pa glud rdzas 'bul ba ni/ de nas ba ri lugs sogs byed na/ sgrol ma'am rta mgrin sogs kyi nga rgyal dang*/ skabs 'dir gu ru drag po'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ hūm̐ dam pa chos skyong srung ma rnams// 'dir ni bcol ba'i las rnams mdzod// mchod sbyin gtor ma glud rdzas 'bul// gnas 'dir gnod pa ma mdzad cig /snang srid lha 'dre sde brgyad po// sngags 'chang bdag gi bka' la nyon// gzhan gyi rbad la ma nyan cig /gdon bgegs chen po thams cad kyang*// bsam sbyor ngan pa zhi bar gyis// khyed rnams dgyes pa'i gtor ma dang*// gzugs brnyan mang po rnams dang ni// la rdzas lung rdzas 'dod dgur bcas// yid 'ong mchod pa spel zhol dang*// dar gyi gur phub ldi ri ri// 'bru tshom dgu yi khri la bzhugs// ngar glud rgyan cha sna tshogs dang*// yid 'ong rta pho legs mgyogs la// 'bru yi ngar mi chen po bskyon// lus la gser g.yu mang pos brgyan// dar gyi gos gyon lhubs se lhub// smra ba mkhas la ngag snyan pa// bzhin ni legs la mdangs re che// 'og na rta zhon zhungs se zhung*// mgo la thod bcings pu ru ru// rtsed 'jo sna tshogs bsgyur la mkhas// g.yu yi l+h+wam chung zu lu lu// gser gyi ske rags khyugs se khyug

/nam rgyang ldem pa sku la brgyan// pho gdong mo gdong mi skad smra// mda' rigs 'dod dgu tshang pa rnams// yon bdag glud du khyed la 'bul// yid 'ong nor rdzas mang po rnams// zhal zas zhim la mngar dgu dang*// g.yog 'khor ngar mi bcu gsum dang*// sman spos mar me'i mchod pa rnams// khyed rnams kun la 'bul lags kyi// sngags pa'i phur kha bsgril ba dang*// yungs kar thun gyis brab pa dang*// zor kha sna tshogs 'phen pa dang*// mnan gtad sbyor ba byed pa dang*// de dag nus pa phyir la bzlog /bon po rnga shang dkrol ba dang*// sngun mar 'ur rdo 'phen pa dang*// drag sngags phra men nye 'byed dang*// sde brgyad drag po bskul ba dang*// de dag nus pa phyir la bzlog /chos skyong lha 'dre thams cad kyang*// la la dkor cha'i shul du 'breng*// la la sngags pa drag po rbad// la la las dang rgyu 'bras ston// la la rims dang dal yams gtong*// 'ga' zhig bden pa'i ser ba 'bebs// char ba mi 'bab lo nyes byed// len chags bu lon 'ded pa dang*// nye 'brel rogs kyi shul du 'brang*// mdze nad gtong ba'i klu rnams dang*// gnod byed lan len 'dre rnams dang*// sha khrag srog dbugs za ba dang*// ngar snabs mi gtsang za ba dang*// 'byung po'i lha dang sa bdag dang*// lo pra sme ba spar kha dang*// kun kyang glud kyis mnyes gyur cig /gnod 'gal ngan pa zhi bar mdzod// bu lon len chags khyer gyur cig /bdag cag longs spyod 'phel bar mdzod// rkyen ngan bar chad phyir la bzlog /rbod gtong nus pa bzlog tu gsol// bsam pa'i don rnams 'grub par mdzod// byams pa'i sems kyi mchod sbyin gyi// snying rje'i stobs kyis dam chos bshad// khyod kyang ma rig 'khor bar 'khyams// da ni byang chub sems bskyed cig /rang gi lus la dpe long la// gzhan gyi lus la gnod ma byed// sdig spangs thar pa'i lam la bkod// nad dang dal yams bzlog tu gsol// tshe dang dbang thang longs spyod dang*// 'bras bu thams cad 'phel bar mdzod// glo bur brgyad cu rtsa bzhi bzlog

/ye 'drogs sum brgya drug cu bzlog /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams྾ /stong phrag brgyad cu'i gdon rnams྾ /yas kyi bdud du g.yos pa྾ /mas kyi sri ru langs pa྾ /pha tshan nang gi rgya 'dre྾ /ma yi byur 'dre langs pa྾ /sdang ba'i dgra rnams bzlog pa dang*// gnod pa'i bgegs rnams ma lus bzlog /gzhan yang lo skeg zla skeg dang*// zhag skeg ma lus bzlog tu gsol// lha 'dre srid la rku ba dang*// phung 'dre ma lus bzlog tu gsol// mi nad phyugs nad thams cad dang*// byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga bzlog /mi kha bra mchu thams cad bzlog /g.yul rnams ma lus zhi bar mdzod// dgra dang yas rnams bzlog tu gsol// myos shing 'thibs pa bsal bar mdzod// nyin gcig pa dang nyin gnyis pa// nyin gsum pa yi rims rnams dang*// rims rnams thams cad zhi bar mdzod// nyam nga bag tsha bzlog tu gsol// 'thab rtsod bzlums par mdzad du gsol// yul phyogs dge zhing dar ba dang*// dam chos phyogs bcur dar bar mdzod// lo brgya thub cing ston brgya mthong ba dang*// bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang*// tshe dang bsod nams dpal du 'bar bar mdzod// mi tshe dge zhing dngos grub ma lus stsol// zhes bsngos nas lan kha yar gtong tshe mchod gtor dang*/ yas rnams gsos te byin brlab bya/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi mchod pa nas bzung 'di'i bar shar mar gtong*/ mthar 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma rnams mdos kyi nang du bsgril lo// drug pa mdos lam bstan pa ni/ sgo dbye ni mdos kha bsgyur la/ spyi bzlog ni/ kye bskyod do gshegs so bgegs dang ma sring tshogs// pho brang de ni da bskyod 'tshal// chibs kha de ni da bsgyur 'tshal// shar gyi sgo bas sgo phye 'tshal// rnam par rgyal bas sgo phye 'tshal// shar phyogs dung sgo dkar po phyes// shar gyi phreng bas phreng gsol 'tshal// rnam par rgyal bas phang gsol 'tshal// mdos 'gro de ni shar du 'gro// glud 'grim de ni shar du 'grim// shar phyogs rgyal po yul 'khor srungs// dri za 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor// khyed kyang mdos kyi bdag po de// mdos bdag la sogs mdos bzhes shig

/glud bdag la sogs glud bzhes shig /da gshegs da ni gshegs re ran// pho brang de ni da bskyod 'tshal// chibs kha de ni da bsgyur 'tshal// hūm̐ bskyod do gshegs so bgegs dang ma sring tshogs// pho brang de ni da bskyod 'tshal// chibs kha de ni da bsgyur 'tshal// lho yi sgo bas sgo phye 'tshal// gshin rje gshed pos sgo phye 'tshal// lho phyogs gser sgo ser po phyes// lho yi phreng bas phreng gsol 'tshal// gshin rje gshed pos phreng gsol 'tshal// mdos 'gro de ni lho ru 'gro// glud 'grim de ni lho ru 'grim// lho phyogs rgyal po 'phags skyes po// gshin rje 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor// khyed kyang mdos kyi bdag po de// mdos bdag la sogs mdos bzhes shig /glud bdag la sogs glud bzhes shig /da gshegs da ni gshegs re ran// pho brang de ni da bskyod 'tshal// chibs kha de ni da bsgyur 'tshal// hūm̐ bskyod do gshegs so bgegs dang ma sring tshogs// pho brang de ni da bskyod྾ /chibs kha de ni da bsgyur྾ /nub kyi sgo bas sgo phye྾ /rta mgrin rgyal pos sgo phye྾ /nub phyogs zangs sgo dmar po྾ /nub kyi phreng bas phreng gsol྾ /rta mgrin rgyal pos phreng gsol྾ /mdos 'gro de ni nub tu྾ /glud 'grim de ni nub tu྾ /nub phyogs rgyal po spyan mi྾ /klu dbang 'bum gyi 'khor gyis྾ /khyed kyang mdos kyi bdag po྾ /mdos bdag la sogs྾ /glud bdag la sogs྾ /da gshegs da ni gshegs re྾ /pho brang de ni da bskyod྾ /chibs kha de ni da bsgyur྾ /hūm̐ bskyod do gshegs so bgegs dang྾ /pho brang de ni da bskyod྾ /chibs kha de ni da bsgyur྾ /byang gi sgo bas sgo phye྾ /bdud rtsi 'khyil bas sgo phye྾ /byang phyogs g.yu sgo sngon po྾ /byang gi phreng bas phreng gsol྾ /bdud rtsi 'khyil bas phreng gsol྾ /mdos 'gro de ni byang du྾ /glud 'grim de ni byang du྾

/byang phyogs rgyal po rnam thos྾ /gnod sbyin 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor// khyed kyang mdos kyi bdag po྾ /mdos bdag la sogs྾ /glud bdag la sogs glud྾ /da gshegs da ni gshegs re྾ /pho brang de ni da bskyod྾ /chibs kha de ni da bsgyur྾ /de nas mdos kyi lam bstan pa ni/ hūm̐ srid pa'i mdos bdag pho mo rnams// lam bstan shar gyi phyogs su bstan// shar gyi phyogs su mi bstan na// dri za pho mo mdos la dgyes// dri za pho mo bod lhang lhang*// srid pa'i mdos chen khyod song la// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la// gnod pa'i rkyen chen ma btang cig /chag che nyam nga bsgyur du gsol// gong bzhin/ lam bstan shar lho mtshams su྾ /shar lho mtshams su mi bstan྾ /me lha pho mo mdos la྾ /me lha pho mo bod lhang ྾ /srid pa'i mdos chen khyod྾ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas྾ /gnod pa'i rkyen chen ma btang ྾ /chag che nyam nga bsgyur du྾ /lam bstan lho yi phyogs su྾ /lho yi phyogs su mi bstan྾ /grul bum pho mo mdos la྾ /grul bum pho mo bod lhang ྾ /srid pa'i mdos chen khyod song ྾ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas྾ /gnod pa'i rkyen chen ma btang ྾ /chag che nyam nga bsgyur du྾ /lam bstan lho nub mtshams su྾ /lho nub mtshams su mi bstan྾ /srin po pho mo mdos las྾ /srin po pho mo bod྾ /srid pa'i mdos chen khyod song ྾ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas྾ /gnod pa'i rkyen chen ma btang ྾ /chag che nyam nga bsgyur du྾ /lam bstan nub kyi phyogs su྾ /nub kyi phyogs su mi bstan na// klu lam dkar po mdos la྾ /klu lam dkar po bod྾ /srid pa'i mdos chen khyod྾ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas྾ /gnod pa'i rkyen chen ma btang ྾ /chag che nyam nga bsgyur du྾ /lam bstan nub byang mtshams su bstan// nub byang mtshams su mi bstan྾ /rlung lha pho mo mdos la྾ /rlung lha pho mo bod྾

/srid pa'i mdos chen khyod྾ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas྾ /gnod pa'i rkyen chen ma btang ྾ /chag che nyam nga bsgyur du྾ /lam bstan byang gi phyogs su྾ /byang gi phyogs su mi bstan྾ /gnod sbyin pho mo mdos la྾ /gnod sbyin pho mo bod྾ /srid pa'i mdos chen khyod song ྾ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas྾ /gnod pa'i rkyen chen྾ /chag che nyam nga bsgyur du྾ /lam bstan byang shar mtshams su྾ /byang shar mtshams su mi bstan྾ /dbang ldan pho mo mdos la྾ /dbang ldan pho mo bod྾ /srid pa'i mdos chen khyod྾ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas྾ /gnod pa'i rkyen chen ma btang ྾ /chag che nyam nga bsgyur du྾ /lam bstan steng gi phyogs su྾ /steng gi phyogs su mi bstan྾ /tshangs pa pho mo mdos la྾ /tshangs pa pho mo bod྾ /srid pa'i mdos chen khyod song ྾ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas྾ /gnod pa'i rkyen chen ma btang ྾ /chag che nyam nga bsgyur du྾ /lam bstan 'og gi phyogs su྾ /'og gi phyogs su mi bstan྾ /sa bdag pho mo mdos la dgyes// sa bdag pho mo bod྾ /srid pa'i mdos chen khyod྾ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas྾ /gnod pa'i rkyen chen ma btang ྾ /chag che nyam nga bsgyur du gsol// da ni mdos kha bsgyur 'tshal/ kye phyogs phyogs nyi ma shar phyogs na// dung lung dkar po'i nang shed na// dung gi rta pho dgo ba tsam// bar re mgyogs la rgya ma rgyug /dung gi mi pho mche ba tsam// smra re mkhas la ldab ma ldib// de la mi bzang rta re bzang*// de na 'gro mkhas gtam re sdug /de na 'khor mang g.yog re hrag /de na gser bzang g.yu re che// de na stag gzig ri mo bkra// ya bdud pho brang da ru bskyod// ma bdud pho brang der bskyod 'tshal// rgyal po'i pho brang der bskyod 'tshal// btsan gyi sho rde der 'grim 'tshal// ma mo'i 'du sa de ru 'tshal// the'u rang bskyal sa de ru mdzod// srin mo'i mtsher sa de ru 'tshal// phyag gi sor brdeg de ru mdzod// ku re bskyal sa de ru 'tshal// 'di na sdod pa'i yul ma mchis// mdos 'di 'bul lo slar ma log
